name: Gauntlet Flurry

boost.name: Ambitious
effect: Draw 3 cards, then Strike.
BEFORE: Close 1 space.
HIT: You gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).

name: Knight Wave

boost.name: Invitation
effect: The opponent must move 1 space, then you may move 1 space, then Strike.
HIT: +2 Power if the opponent has more cards in hand than you.
AFTER: Move 1 space.

name: Ballista

boost.name: Backstep & Lunge
effect: Retreat 2 spaces.
BEFORE: Close 2 spaces.
BEFORE: +1 Power for each card in your Gauge (max 5).
HIT: Close 4 spaces and gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).

name: Chivalry

boost.name: Bracing
effect: +1 Armor and +1 Guard at the start of each of the opponent's turns.
BEFORE: Advance 2 spaces.
HIT: You gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).

name: Gallant Defender

boost.name: Opportunist
effect: +2 Speed and +2 Power. If your opponent declares a Strike discard this card.
BEFORE: Close 3 spaces.
HIT: +1 Power for each point of damage you have taken this Strike.

name: Sovereign Glory

boost.name: Street Justice
effect: +2 Power if you are in Exceed Mode. +2 Speed if an opponent is in Exceed Mode.
BEFORE: Draw 2 cards. HIT: +1 Power for each card in hand you have more than the opponent.

name: Checkmate

boost.name: Mixup
effect: Your opponent must discard a card at random, then you Strike.
Attacks at range 1 do not hit you.
